note: Every piece of text the level creator shows (task T-233). The creator is the board's own tool, never shipped to players, so the labels are plain. Buttons fit about 16 characters, panel category names about 12. Each entry has a text and a where note. Change a text here, no code change.

list_title.where: Title at the top of the list screen.

new_level_button.where: List screen: button that creates a level; the only thing on the list when there are no levels.

play_action.where: List screen: button on each listed level, starts it as a full run.

edit_action.where: List screen: button on each listed level, opens it in the editor.

default_level_name.where: Editor: the name a new level starts with.

name_field_label.where: Editor: label of the level name field.

category_ground.where: Editor side panel: category of ground tiles.

category_roads.where: Editor side panel: category of road pieces.

category_buildings.where: Editor side panel: category of buildings.

category_boulders.where: Editor side panel: category of boulders.

category_rooftops.where: Editor side panel: category of rooftops.

category_ramps.where: Editor side panel: category of ramps.

rooftop_height_3.where: Editor side panel, Rooftops: label of the height 3 rooftop.

rooftop_height_6.where: Editor side panel, Rooftops: label of the height 6 rooftop.

ramp_height_0_3.where: Editor side panel, Ramps: label of the ramp from the street (0) up to height 3.

ramp_height_3_6.where: Editor side panel, Ramps: label of the ramp from height 3 up to height 6.

rotate_label.where: Editor: button that switches the piece to its next view.

mirror_label.where: Editor: button that flips the piece.

style_label.where: Editor top bar: button that steps the style (textures) of the next rooftop or ramp placed; {style} is the style's name.

style_office.where: Editor top bar, Style button: the office rooftop and office wall textures.

style_carpark.where: Editor top bar, Style button: the car park deck and garage wall textures.

style_t198.where: Editor top bar, Style button: the first placeholder textures (T-198's).

delete_label.where: Editor: button that removes the selected piece.

save_label.where: Editor: button that saves the level.

save_confirmation.where: Editor: message shown after a successful save.

overlap_message.text: Can't place here: it overlaps another piece.
overlap_message.where: Editor: message shown when a piece can't be placed because it overlaps another piece.

back_button.where: Editor: button that returns to the list screen.

controls_hint.text: Mouse: place. R: rotate. M: mirror. T: style. Del: delete.
controls_hint.where: Editor: hint line along the screen edge listing the controls.

size_hint.where: Editor top bar: hint while the board drags out a rooftop's size (T-251).

size_readout.where: Editor top bar: width and depth readout while sizing a rooftop; {w} and {d} are filled in by the creator (T-251).

ramp_dir_north.where: Editor top bar: direction of a picked ramp, climbing north (T-251).

ramp_dir_east.where: Editor top bar: direction of a picked ramp, climbing east (T-251).

ramp_dir_south.where: Editor top bar: direction of a picked ramp, climbing south (T-251).

ramp_dir_west.where: Editor top bar: direction of a picked ramp, climbing west (T-251).

ramp_height_0_6.where: Editor top bar or side panel, Ramps: height label of a ramp from the street (0) up to height 6, if T-251 adds one.

ramp_height_0_2.where: Editor top bar and looks strip, Ramps: height label of the small jump ramp on the street, from 0 up to 2 (T-400).

ramp_height_3_5.where: Editor top bar and looks strip, Ramps: height label of the small jump ramp on a height 3 rooftop, from 3 up to 5 (T-400).

ramp_height_6_8.where: Editor top bar and looks strip, Ramps: height label of the small jump ramp on a height 6 rooftop, from 6 up to 8 (T-400).

road_corner.where: Editor side panel, Roads: label of the corner road tile (T-252).

road_t_junction.where: Editor side panel, Roads: label of the T-junction road tile (T-252).

road_crossroads.where: Editor side panel, Roads: label of the crossroads road tile (T-252).

road_dead_end.where: Editor side panel, Roads: label of the dead end road tile (T-252).

category_props.where: Editor side panel: category of props (T-253).

prop_barrier.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the concrete barrier (T-253).

prop_cones.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the traffic cones (T-253).

prop_crates.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the crate stack (T-253).

prop_ac_unit.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the air conditioning unit (T-253).

prop_water_tank.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the rooftop water tank (T-253).

prop_roof_vent.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the roof vent (T-253).

prop_street_lamp.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the street lamp (T-253).

prop_roof_sign.where: Editor side panel, Props: label of the rooftop sign (T-253).

building_small.where: Editor side panel, Buildings: label of the small square building (T-254).

building_long.where: Editor side panel, Buildings: label of the long building (T-254).

controls_hint_sizing.text: Mouse: place. Drag: size a rooftop. R: rotate. M: mirror. T: style. Del: delete.
controls_hint_sizing.where: Editor: hint line along the screen edge, the controls with dragging to size a rooftop added (T-250). Replaces controls_hint, which is kept unchanged.

group_roads.where: Editor side panel (T-261): group of road pieces.

group_ground.where: Editor side panel (T-261): group of ground tiles.

group_levels.where: Editor side panel (T-261): group of height pieces, platforms and ramps.

group_buildings.where: Editor side panel (T-261): group of buildings.

group_obstacles.where: Editor side panel (T-261): group of things in the way, boulders, barriers, cones and crates.

group_decoration.where: Editor side panel (T-261): group of street and rooftop decoration.

piece_road.where: Editor side panel, Roads (T-261): button for the plain road, painted by dragging.

piece_centre_line.where: Editor side panel, Roads (T-261): button for the road marking along the middle of a road.

piece_zebra_crossing.where: Editor side panel, Roads (T-261): button for the zebra crossing.

piece_cracked_road.where: Editor side panel, Roads (T-261): button for the cracked road.

piece_gravel.where: Editor side panel, Ground (T-261): button for the gravel ground.

piece_pavement.where: Editor side panel, Ground (T-261): button for the pavement ground.

piece_platform.where: Editor side panel, Levels (T-261): button for a raised platform (a rooftop).

piece_ramp.where: Editor side panel, Levels (T-261): button for a ramp.

piece_building_small.where: Editor side panel, Buildings (T-261): button for the small building (same wording as building_small).

piece_building_long.where: Editor side panel, Buildings (T-261): button for the long building (same wording as building_long).

piece_building_lowrise.where: Editor side panel, Buildings (T-261): button for the low-rise building.

piece_building_skyscraper.where: Editor side panel, Buildings (T-261): button for the skyscraper.

piece_boulder.where: Editor side panel, Obstacles (T-261): button for a boulder.

piece_barrier.where: Editor side panel, Obstacles (T-261): button for the concrete barrier (short form of prop_barrier).

piece_cones.where: Editor side panel, Obstacles (T-261): button for the traffic cones.

piece_crates.where: Editor side panel, Obstacles (T-261): button for the crate stack.

piece_street_lamp.where: Editor side panel, Decoration (T-261): button for the street lamp.

piece_ac_unit.where: Editor side panel, Decoration (T-261): button for the air conditioning unit.

piece_water_tank.where: Editor side panel, Decoration (T-261): button for the rooftop water tank.

piece_roof_vent.where: Editor side panel, Decoration (T-261): button for the roof vent.

piece_roof_sign.where: Editor side panel, Decoration (T-261): button for the rooftop sign.

looks_heading.where: Editor side panel, strip under a selected piece (T-261): heading of its row of looks.

look_counter.where: Editor side panel, looks strip (T-261): which look is chosen; {n} and {count} are filled in by the creator.

platform_size_s.where: Editor top bar, Platform (T-261): button for the small platform size.

platform_size_m.where: Editor top bar, Platform (T-261): button for the medium platform size.

platform_size_l.where: Editor top bar, Platform (T-261): button for the large platform size.

platform_size_any.where: Editor top bar, Platform (T-261): button to drag out a platform of any size.

ramp_arrows_up.where: Editor top bar, Ramp (T-261): button that makes the ramp's direction arrows point up the slope.

ramp_arrows_down.where: Editor top bar, Ramp (T-261): button that makes the ramp's direction arrows point down the slope.

banner_on.where: Editor top bar, Skyscraper (T-261): button that puts a banner on the skyscraper.

banner_off.where: Editor top bar, Skyscraper (T-261): button that takes the banner off.

road_brush_hint.where: Editor top bar, Road (T-261): hint while painting a road.

controls_hint_rework.text: Drag: paint roads, size platforms. R: turn. V: next look. M: mirror. H: height. A: arrows. B: banner. T: style. Del: delete.
controls_hint_rework.where: Editor: hint line along the screen edge for the reworked creator (T-261). Replaces controls_hint_sizing, which is kept unchanged.

pair_tool.where: Editor top bar or side panel, Obstacles (T-271): button of the tool that marks two obstacles as a pair, for the thread the needle trick.

pair_hint.where: Editor top bar (T-271): hint while the pair tool is picked, before the second obstacle is clicked.

pair_made.where: Editor top bar (T-271): message after two obstacles are marked as a pair.

pair_not_obstacle.text: Not an obstacle. Pick a boulder, barrier, cones or crates.
pair_not_obstacle.where: Editor top bar (T-271): message when a click with the pair tool lands on something that isn't an obstacle.

unpair_label.where: Editor top bar (T-271): button that removes the pair from a selected paired obstacle.

controls_hint_pairs.text: Drag: paint roads, size platforms. R: turn. V: next look. M: mirror. H: height. A: arrows. B: banner. P: pair. T: style. Del: delete.
controls_hint_pairs.where: Editor: hint line along the screen edge with the pair key added (T-271). Replaces controls_hint_rework, which is kept unchanged.

spawn_label.where: Editor map (T-279): label on the spawn point's marker, where the car starts a run.

spawn_hint.text: Start: drag to move. R: turn.
spawn_hint.where: Editor top bar (T-279): hint while the spawn point is selected; R turns the car's starting heading, the same key as turning a piece.

spawn_blocked.where: Editor top bar (T-279): message when the spawn point is dropped inside a building, on an obstacle or off the map; it goes back to where it was.

spawn_no_delete.where: Editor top bar (T-279): message when the board tries to delete the spawn point; a level always has one.

controls_hint_spawn.text: Drag: paint roads, size platforms, move the start. R: turn. V: next look. M: mirror. H: height. A: arrows. B: banner. P: pair. T: style. Del: delete.
controls_hint_spawn.where: Editor: hint line along the screen edge with moving the start added (T-279). Replaces controls_hint_pairs, which is kept unchanged.

piece_sidewalk.where: Editor side panel, Ground (T-396): button for the sidewalk, painted by dragging; the curb is added where it meets a road (T-398).

piece_meteor_crater.where: Editor side panel, Ground (T-401): button for the meteor crater, after Sidewalk; the car drives over it (T-398).

piece_parked_car.where: Editor side panel, Obstacles (T-396): button for the parked car, after Crates (T-398).

piece_broken_car.where: Editor side panel, Obstacles (T-396): button for the broken car, after Parked car (T-398).

model_counter.where: Editor side panel, looks strip under a picked parked car, broken car or meteor crater (T-396, T-401): which model is chosen; {n} and {count} are filled in by the creator (T-398).

facing_top_right.where: Editor top bar (T-396): the facing of a picked parked or broken car, turned with R (T-398).

facing_bottom_right.where: Editor top bar (T-396): the facing of a picked parked or broken car, turned with R (T-398).

facing_bottom_left.where: Editor top bar (T-396): the facing of a picked parked or broken car, turned with R (T-398).

facing_top_left.where: Editor top bar (T-396): the facing of a picked parked or broken car, turned with R (T-398).
